CyUI 1.0.0 - themed Dear ImGui controls

Source supplied by Cyberalien: CyImgui_Interface library
Snapshot: 2026-10-17. MIT license: LICENSE, unchanged.
Only include/, src/, CMakeLists.txt and LICENSE are vendored, without changes.
The demo's ImGui copy, Python wrappers and build outputs are not included.
CyGPUInspector builds CyUI with its existing Dear ImGui target; no sibling
checkout, extra application or system font installation is required at runtime.
Integration guide: upstream docs/AI_GUIDE.md.
